title: Filtering the products table by numbers · part 14

steps.title: Filter then sort: category_id <= 3
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE category_id <= 3 ORDER BY category_id LIMIT 3;

Add WHERE category_id <= 3.
